title: Topbar clips the language toggle in Spanish below ~1280px
description: Pre-existing on dev, independent of the screen-04 label. Above the 1125px narrow breakpoint the .topbar is a no-wrap flex row and body has overflow-x:hidden, so the overflow is clipped rather than scrollable. In Spanish the longer nav labels push .tb-meta past the viewport: measured at a 1200px viewport the #lang-btn right edge lands at 1278px, i.e. 78px off-screen and unreachable. At 1280px it clears by 2px. English fits (32px to spare at 1200px). The band roughly 1126-1280px in Spanish therefore has no reachable language toggle - which covers 1280x800 and 1366x768 laptops in the ES default. Below 1125px the pill wraps to width:100% with overflow-x:auto and is safe.
design: Options: lower the desktop breakpoint so the wrap kicks in earlier; let .tb-meta shrink or drop the Disponible status before the toggle; or move #lang-btn inside the .pill so it inherits the horizontal scroll.
acceptance_criteria: #lang-btn is fully visible and clickable in both languages from 1126px upward.

title: Simplificar portafolio: quitar peso de la metáfora alquímica, priorizar señal
description:
El portafolio actual está construido sobre una metáfora de alquimia/Fullmetal Alchemist (cita de Edward Elric, 'Ley de equivalencia', sellos chakana, 'Catálogo de especímenes', 'Linaje y filiación', 'Procedencia del operador'). La envoltura conceptual pesa más que la señal: un reclutador o ingeniero que entra ~20s no encuentra rápido 'qué construyó y con qué'. El contenido real es sólido (Applied ML Engineer, 3 sistemas + 1 paper en CCIS) pero queda enterrado bajo la temática y la jerga. Es aburrido y complejo de forma innecesaria.

Objetivo: reducir fricción y subir la densidad de señal sin perder personalidad. Posicionamiento systems-first (ver memoria de tono editorial).
design: Estructura actual: Hero -> Tesis(cita FMA) -> Catálogo(3) -> Research full-bleed -> Linaje(experiencia) -> Credentials -> Skills -> Footer (7+ secciones, App.tsx 102 líneas). Candidatos a recortar/fusionar: sección Tesis con epígrafe de Elric; nomenclatura 'espécimen/linaje/operador/ley de equivalencia'; sellos alquímicos decorativos. Mantener: 3 sistemas, paper Imitator, experiencia CIP/Visma, stack. Pendiente brainstorming de rumbo (cuánto tema conservar vs. quitar del todo) y si se usa companion visual para comparar layouts.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Un visitante identifica rol + 1-2 proyectos clave en menos de 20s. 2) Se elimina o reduce drásticamente la jerga temática (especímenes, linaje, ley de equivalencia, cita FMA). 3) Menos secciones o secciones más cortas; menos scroll. 4) Se conserva el contenido factual (3 sistemas, paper, experiencia). 5) npm run lint && npm run build pasan.
notes: Layout corregido 2026-05-31: el usuario eligio variante C (proyectos en FILAS, todo a la vista, SIN expansion) sobre D. Mantiene estetica fria, hero recruiter-first, quick-facts. Spec y mockup de referencia actualizados a C.

title: Fix PR52 technical SEO: lockfile, 404 typography, Vesper palette, JSON-LD claims
description: PR52 (feat/github-mention-... -> dev) ships technical SEO but CI build-check is red and several details contradict repo policy. Lockfile: the node_modules/@astrojs/sitemap entry was hand-written with no dependencies block and no integrity hash, so npm ci installs a tree missing sitemap/zod/stream-replace-string and astro build dies. 404: h1 line-height .82 makes glyph ink overflow the line box by 0.1724*font-size, so the Signal descender strikes through the paragraph above ~830px viewport. Palette: #72ffae/#6946ff/rgba(92,48,255)/rgba(82,255,165) appear nowhere in the repo, its history or node_modules - they are invented, while the PR plan promises Vesper-native assets. JSON-LD: knowsAbout carries 'Urban ML' which is unsupported by cv/master.md or evidence/claims.md, and the rewrite dropped description, knowsLanguage and 5 knowsAbout entries.
design: Lockfile: delete only the corrupt entry then npm install (+71/-4, no unrelated drift) rather than full regeneration (+318/-362). 404: padding-bottom .19em on the h1, which scales with the clamp(). Palette: --v-green #3be0a6 and --v-violet #8b7bff; use var(--font-sans)/var(--font-mono) from tokens.css instead of literal family names. JSON-LD: keep the ProfilePage wrapper, restore description/knowsLanguage/the 9-item knowsAbout, replace OrganizationRole with a plain Organization carrying the canonical name, and use affiliation rather than alumniOf since graduation is expected 2026-2.
acceptance_criteria: npm ci && npm run build && npm run check all pass; no glyph collision at 390/768/1200/1440/1920; no invented hexes remain; JSON-LD claims all traceable to cv/master.md.
close_reason: Lockfile repaired surgically (+71/-4, no unrelated drift); npm ci + build + check all green; sitemap emits 5 real URLs with /404/ filtered. 404 h1 gets padding-bottom .19em - clearance +19px at 768/1200/1920 across all three candidate strings including the two-line case. Palette moved to the real Vesper hexes and tokens.css font vars. JSON-LD restored description/knowsLanguage/9-item knowsAbout, dropped the unsupported Urban ML, replaced OrganizationRole with a plain Organization under the canonical CIP name, and uses affiliation instead of alumniOf.

El MCP claude_design corta get_file en 256 KiB (campo truncated:true). Assets mas pesados (video, portadas) llegan incompletos y no hay forma de paginarlos. Los PNG/base64 pequenos que si llegan enteros pero quedan solo en contexto se pueden extraer del transcript JSONL de la sesion en ~/.claude/projects/<slug>/<session-id>.jsonl con un regex sobre el JSON del tool result, en vez de re-transcribir el base64 a mano (que se corrompe).
